content: Ieisu Tomoꞌotoqa 4,000 Ivekanidi
Tutuyanina waineye yoko bwaigina imai imiakauqa ge mekadi beqa Ieisu kanatovemulivo iqoledi imai waineye ivonedi ivo,
“Yoko dede taiauda tamiamia gunabei kaiata kaitonu ge mekadi beqa avenuainainaqeyedi.
Kago mesai aivetunedi inanaqo divanuqe mekadilase kedeye inabeku. Wete mesai tupwaidiavo malaveꞌeqa imai.”
We kanatovemulivo ibaivila waineye ivo, “Ge tamo aitoi de waineye idamiamia. Vakaiebei beledi taikewadi tomoꞌotoqa taivekanidi?”
Matautauda ivelautoliedi ivo, “Kaivia beledi waimie?” We ibaivila ivo, “Beledi 7.”
Beqa yoko ivonedi pwayepwayeye imiabui beledi 7 ikewadi ivelaukui Yaubada waineye. Matautauda beledi igiatomwai ikalaqeiedi kanatovemulivo waidie yoko inavekanidi, we de mesai ivalabubunedi.
Wete iqana siaidi tupwaidiavo ikenokeno ikewadi ivelaukui paipaidi Yaubada waineye. Matautauda kanatovemulivo ivonedi ivo, “Yoko puedi kwaveledi inakani.”
We tomoꞌotoqa puedi ikani ikabiawa. Wete nigila puena kanatovemulivo igwagwadi ginae 7 iveadaqidi mekanikaninidi.
No waineye tomoꞌotoqa kadiyoko oge mesai 4,000 Ieisu ivekanidi. Mulineye ivetunedi inaqo divanuqe.
Palisivo* Ivelautoli Yaubada Nakiakiaya Paipaina
Tutuyanina waineye vedimadimanaeqa Ieisu idodoqa waga waineye kanatovemulivo taiau inaqo vikai Dalimanuta waineye.
No waineye tupwaidiavo Palisivo* imai ivekaiwewewena taiauda. Wayaqidi Ieisu inavekautovoni beqa ivelautolieni ivo, “Kima wayaqima kiakiaya kabanuavilele* Yaubada waineyeꞌeqa imai kivevema.”
Ieisu nuapouna iveviqa ikalayawaina ivo, “Vakai paipaina komi lagata dede kwaelautoliegu tamo kiakiaya aivalabubuni paipaimi? Aivonemi mwaqitana, ge kiakiaya aivalabubuni kwaikiseni.”
Ieisu Kanatovemulivo Igiavepakalidi Palisivo* wete Elodi Divalabubuna Kapoidi Paipaidi
Matautauda Ieisu mekanatovemulivo Palisivo* ikiawedi ivila inaqo wageye idodoqa inabala mali vikaie Waya Galili waineye.
We kanatovemulivo nuadi ivulu beledi ge idakewadi, we kaitamoqanaqa ikewai taiauda wageye.
Tutuyanina waineye Ieisu igiavepakalidi ivo, “Kwavekisabodebodemi Palisivo* wete Elodi diꞌisiti ge waineye kwaisikwana.”
We kanatovemulivo kaisekavadi waidie iesipupu vakai Ieisu gunabei ivesipupuyeni waidie paipaina ivo, “Beledi ge tadakewadi beqa isiti paipaina iesipupu.”
We Ieisu iyagovi vakai iesipupuyeni ivonedi ivo, “Banikodiqa, kwaenuanedi we mesai kwavo beledi ge tamo kadakewai? Komi giladi ge kwadanuakawananaqai paipaigu! Nuami tabodadi ge idakawabwegabwegadi!

Komi mematami we ge kwadakisa vekavekai! Komi metaniqami we ge kwadanoqaya vekavekai! Kwanuani vakai avalabubunidi base beledi 5 agiatomwai akalaqeiedi 5,000 tomoꞌotoqa kadiyoko avekanidi. We kaivia nigila meginaedi kwaveadaqidi?” We ibaivila ivo, “Ginae 12.”
Matautauda ivelautoliedi ivo, “No tutuyanina beledi 7 agiatomwai akalaqeiedi 4,000 tomoꞌotoqa kadiyoko avekanidi, kaivia ginae nigila kwaveadaqidi?” We ibaivila ivo, “Ginae 7.”
Matautauda ivonedi ivo, “Banikodiqa, giladi ge kwadanuakawananaqai vakai avesipupuyeni?”
Betisaida Waineye Ieisu Tomoqo Matana Pwalupwaluna Ikavegiagiamaia

Matautauda Ieisu mekanatovemulivo inaqo vanuqa bwaigina Betisaida waineye. No waineye tupwaidiavo tomoꞌotoqa tomoqo matana pwalupwaluna imaieni waineye ivelaukuieni wayaqidi inakavikavini inakavegiagiamaia.
We Ieisu tomoqo matana pwalupwaluna dimaneye ikavikavina iluguaqeteni vanuqeꞌeqa. Matautauda tomoqo matana igiwalidi, dimana iyatoi matana waidie ivelautolieni ivo, “Kanasala vakai kikisedi?”
Tomoqo ikisalagata ivo, “Tomoꞌotoqa akisedi mesaida welavi iekalatauya.”
We Ieisu dimana iyato vaituqani tomoqo mataneye, matautauda tomoqo matana ikisalagata ivegiagiamai ikisa vekavekai.
Matautauda ivesipupu ivo, “Ge kinaqo vanuqa bwaigina waineye tonotonovina kuvila kunaqo muvanuqe.”
Pita Ivesipupuyeni Ieisu Keliso Yaubada Kanavesivesinua
Matautauda Ieisu mekanatovemulivo inaqo Sisalia Pilipai vanuqa bwaigina vivineye. Tutuyanina itauya inaqonaqo kedeye ivonedi ivo, “Banikodiqa tomoꞌotoqa iesipupu nigodibei Yau aitoi?”

We ibaivila ivo, “Tupwaidiavo tomoꞌotoqa iesipupu ivo, ‘Kana Dioni Tobabitaiso’, tupwaidiavo iesipupu ivo, ‘Kana Yaubada natovesipupu Ilaitia gumanina basenaqai imiamia,’ we tupwaidiavo iesipupu ivo, ‘Kana Yaubada natovesipupu basenaqai imiamia iyawasa vaituqana.’”
Matautauda ivelautoliedi ivo, “We komi, banikodiqa kwaesipupu nigodibei Yau aitoi?” Pita ibaivila ivo, “Komu Keliso Yaubada Kanavesivesinua!*”
Matautauda igiavepakalidi ivo, “Ge kanasala tamo aitoi kwaivoneni Yau paipaigu kwanavo ‘Gumanina Keliso Yaubada Kanavesivesinua.*’”
Ieisu Kanatovemulivo Ivonedi Kamukabeida Inawapa Mulineye Wapaeqa Inatovoi Vaituqana

Matautauda ivelamu kanatovemulivo waidie ivesipupu vakai inasauyeni waineye paipaina. Ivo, “Yau, Mwaqitana Kanatomoqo*, aiveviqa bwaigina, matautauda Diu tomoqovo bwaigidi, tovelomuvo bwaigidi* wete Mosese naloina kanatovekaivevenavo inabailegu. We kaguqaviavo inaluvewapagu, we kaiata kaitonu inakakava wapaeqa aitovoi vaituqana.”
De mesai iesipupuyedi inuakawananaqai beqa Pita ikewaluguaqeteni saiqanaqa iveqanaqo ivoneni bonana veluveluluninaeqa ivo, “Komu ge muwapa paipaina kivesipupu luguaqeta!”
We itunuvilai kanatovemulivo ikisedi Pita ivoneni bonana veluveluluninaeqa ivo, “Seitani, kuveqanaqo waigueꞌeqa! Komu munuanua ge mesai Yaubada nanuanua, we komu tomoꞌotoqa dinuanuana mesai.”
Ieisu Kanavemuli Kananuakawananaqai

Matautauda Ieisu yoko iqoledi wete kanatovemulivo taiau imai vivineye waidie ivesipupu, “Kago komi wayaqimi kwaivemulieguqa, taunimi migiamaina kwaibailedi, we kamilaukenobalabala kwaikewai kwaikavalai matautauda kwaivemuliegu.
Aitoi wayaqina yawaina inavekokoleni inamiakapo, we yawaina vaqata inakaivuyovuyoi. We aitoi yawaina inakaivuyovuyoi we inavemuliegu we Guvalea Giamaina inavekimataneni, yawaina vaqata inababaneni.
We kago tamo aitoi saku puepuena giamaina inakewadi pwayapwaya de waineye, we yawaina vaqata ge inakewaiqa noko sakunidiavo ge inakaivaiseni.
Paina kago tomoqo yawaina vaqata inakaivuyovuyoi, ge kanasala takonaeqa inatakonai we inakewavileni.

Beqa komi lagata dede waineye kwamiamiaqa kaisemi mikedakeda kwaemuliedi ge kwadavekimatana vekavekaiegu, paina komi mesai tomoꞌotoqa gumanidiavo gimala ivalabubunidi wete tupwaidiavo saku kapoidi ivavalabubunidi. Kago aitoi lagata dede waineye inavovomayamayaqegu we guvekaivevena inavovomayamayaqedi matautauda mulineye Yau, Mwaqitana Kanatomoqo,* gumanina aivovomayamayaqeni tutuyanina aivila aimai pwayapwaya dede waineye Tamagu mataꞌuduꞌudulinaeqa wete naꞌanelosevo pilopilodi taiauda.”

footnotes.text: Tamo tutuya me-Diu dinuanuana isiti mesai vonawakedubala tupwaidiavo valabubuna kapoidi isasapayavuledi tomoꞌotoqa waidie paipaidi, mesai isiti pwalawa ikakavebwaigi. Tutuyanina Ieisu isiti paipaina iesipupu, noko Palisivo* wete Elodi divekaivevena we dibubuna kapoidi paipaidi iesipupu.
Vonawakedubala dede: “Kamilaukenobalabala kwaikewai” kananuakawananaqai kwaitagwanemi kwaiveviqa we kwaiwapa.
